---
title: "Install R packages for practical sessions 1 and 2"
output: html_document
author: "Ricardo Leitão"
---

Run this once before the first session. It installs every package used in both practical sessions.

# Bioconductor packages

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")

BiocManager::install(c(
  "ShortRead", "dada2", "Biostrings",   # practical session 1
  "phyloseq",                           # sessions 1 and 2
  "DESeq2", "microbiome"                # practical session 2
))
```

# CRAN packages

```{r}
install.packages(c(
  "ggplot2", "rmarkdown", "knitr",                     # both sessions
  "RColorBrewer", "vegan", "ggvenn", "dplyr",          # practical session 2
  "ggpubr", "scales", "ragg", "gplots"                 # practical session 2
))
```

# Check that everything loads

```{r}
pkgs <- c("ShortRead", "dada2", "Biostrings", "phyloseq", "DESeq2", "microbiome",
          "ggplot2", "rmarkdown", "knitr", "RColorBrewer", "vegan", "ggvenn",
          "dplyr", "ggpubr", "scales", "ragg", "gplots")
missing <- pkgs[!vapply(pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) message("Not installed: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", ")) else message("All packages installed.")
```
